I made a portrait for President Seras Stultz with couple versions

https://imgur.com/a/FQYtX

First image: The first image includes a regular Seras Stultz. She has somewhat long curly hair that goes slightly below her shoulders. It's a little hard to distinguish but she also has a ponytail (the part of her hair that touches her shoulder is the ponytail anyways)

Second Image: I thought it would look pretty cool/cute(?) to give her a Tattoo, it may look a little unprofessional but perhaps things would be different in the future. It also gives her a more unique look that implies her personality.

Tattoo: https://i.imgur.com/FXMcNoW.png

what do you think?<ac_metadata title="Seras Stultz Portrait pic (and Reed Chen Remastered)"> </ac_metadata>
